purpose: Teach: 智子/秀夫/美香/花園/小人/夫君/姐/追い出し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが友人の智子さんと文通された
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he used to correspond with our friend Tomoko.
lines.style: Soft, remembering tone. Gentle opening. Long, winding phrasing like following a thread back in time. Almost conversational with himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、秀夫兄さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and you, when you were young, you used to play shogi with your brother Hideo, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm and playful. Light tilt toward him. Teasing affection underneath. The rhythm of someone turning his own memory back on him gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが姪の美香さんを可愛がられた
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he was so fond of our niece Mika.
lines.style: Tender drift. Soft attach on 「可愛がられた」. Letting the affection sit for a moment. Like placing something precious down to look at it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、皇居の花園に散歩されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—and you, when you were young, you used to take walks through the Imperial Palace gardens, didn't you?
lines.style: Bright, knowing. A small laugh riding under the words. The pleasure of catching him in his own storytelling. Affectionate correction without any sting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが芸能の小人プロレスを観られた
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he saw dwarf wrestling matches at the theater.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost matter-of-fact. A small smile in the voice—acknowledging something odd or delightful that he remembers. Honest, not embellishing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご友人の智子さんの夫君と仲良くされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—and you, when you were young, you were close with Tomoko's husband, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Knowing and warm. A small laugh underneath. She's catching him again—turning his story into theirs. The comfort of two people who have lived long enough to remember the same things.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「町内の姐さんは情に厚い」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he used to say the neighborhood women had such generous hearts.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle. Quoting as if reaching back for the exact words. Respect for what his father observed. Quiet weight to the phrase.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、定年退職の追い出し会を御自ら企画されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—and you, when you were younger, you even organized your own retirement party, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright, a little proud of him. Playful teasing at the edge. The rhythm of someone who loves someone well enough to mirror his own heart back at him with a smile.
